title: SearchStaysRequest
description: Checkpoint C.0.1 design contract for the future search_stays MCP tool (docs/adr/0003-phase2-checkpoint-c0-serving-contract.md §6). Not yet wired to a production tool. Dates, if supplied, are used only to compute nights/estimated_total -- they never imply or filter on availability. Every optional filter field is typed to exclude null; an omitted key means 'no filter', an explicit empty array on a list filter is a contradictory-filter request, not 'no filter' (enforced here via minItems on each list filter). ranking_mode is 'preliminary_price_value_desc' -- Travel MCP never claims to compute or accept a request for the final deal_score_desc ranking, since itinerary_accessibility is System-B-owned and unavailable to a standalone search_stays call (Checkpoint C.0.1 §1 correction).

room_types.description: Checkpoint C.0.1 §4 correction: intentionally NOT a closed enum of the known vocabulary. Every requested value -- 'Hotel room', 'Shared room', or a genuinely unrecognized future string -- must reach the semantic room-type validator and fail as UNSUPPORTED_ROOM_TYPE uniformly, never as a generic schema-level INVALID_REQUEST. Only a bounded string length/list size is enforced here.

ranking_mode.description: The only ranking mode search_stays itself performs (docs/adr/0003-phase2-checkpoint-c0-serving-contract.md §1). The canonical six-component deal_score_desc ranking is computed by System A after an A2A round trip with System B, not by this tool -- there is no request field for it here.
